title: THE STASH SLOT BADGE IS A CLEAR PILL
why: Seen on the 4K stash screenshot of 2026-10-08: the 1 or 2 that marks a gun equipped as primary or secondary was a bare amber sliver hugging its digit, pushed into the rounded corner of the tile so the corner cut it. It is a small rounded pill now, set in from the corner.
now: The 1 and 2 on equipped guns in the stash are easy to read.

edits.replacement: (inSlot?(''+inSlot+''):''); // v16.xx, seen on the 4K stash screenshot (2026-10-08): the slot number was a bare amber sliver jammed into the rounded corner
